_comment: Machina shared JSON-LD context for IPTC Sport Schema 1.1.
Every sportschema.org and cv.iptc.org IRI below was COPIED from the pinned
upstream artefacts, not typed from memory. Sources, all under
agent-templates/iptc-mappings/references/iptc-sport-schema-1.1/:
- tools/prefixes.ttl                (upstream's own prefix list)
- ontologies/*.ttl @prefix headers   (per-ontology bindings)
- shacl/iptc-sport-shacl.ttl         (shape-side bindings)
- vocabularies/*.ttl @prefix headers (controlled-vocabulary bindings)
Upstream pin: github.com/iptc/sport-schema @ 0e77bf8678f3702fe81c28673bede35efe47d633
Upstream licence: CC-BY 4.0. See ../references/iptc-sport-schema-1.1/LICENSE.md.
tools/iptc/context.py asserts every sportschema.org / cv.iptc.org binding
here against the vendored bytes. Editing a value without editing the pin
will fail that check.
The rdf / rdfs / xsd / owl / skos / sh / dcterms / prov bindings are the
standard W3C and Dublin Core namespaces. They are stated explicitly rather
than assumed, because a serializer that omits them emits terms that expand
to nothing. prov: is present because Machina graphs carry provenance; it is
not part of IPTC Sport Schema.
machina: is the Machina extension namespace. Anything IPTC 1.1 does not
define goes here or into event_view — NEVER under sport:. See
docs/rfcs/001-machina-iptc-sport-schema-profile.md.
SPELLING NOTES, verified rather than assumed:
- baseball statistics prefix is 'spbblstat', not 'spbstat' or 'spbasestat'.
- motor racing statistics prefix is 'spmcrstat', not 'spmotorstat'.
- the facets prefix is 'spfacet' and its IRI path segment is 'sport-facets'.
- upstream binds golf under TWO names for ONE IRI: 'spgolf' (in
ontologies/iptc-sport-golf.ttl and shacl/iptc-sport-shacl.ttl) and
'spgolstat' (in ontologies/iptc-sport-ontology.ttl). Both are reproduced
below so either upstream spelling round-trips. Machina serializers SHOULD
emit 'spgolf'.
- upstream's prefix for schema.org is 'schemaorg', not 'schema'. Machina
binds BOTH names to https://schema.org/ so that legacy in-repo payloads
using 'schema:' keep expanding to the same IRIs. The IRI is what carries
meaning; the short name does not.
- the soccer ACTION-TYPE vocabulary prefix is 'spsocactiontype' and its IRI
path segment is 'spsocaction' (they differ). No spsocaction.ttl exists
upstream at this commit, so values in this scheme cannot be validated
offline. See UPSTREAM.md, 'Known gap'.
